### Documentation Quality (Required for changed code)

- [ ] For every new or changed non-trivial function/class/public API, I added/updated docstrings focused on intended use, preconditions/invariants, and side effects.
- [ ] I removed or updated stale comments/docstrings that no longer match behavior.
